_about: Ride UK's detached houses (beenster Nov 26: house pack sheets as the look to aim for; our own designs): whole houses modelled by Tools/blender_house_kit.py (designs in Tools/house_kit_designs.py), which writes this file and house_kit.bin (the warehouse kit's piece format). Each design: its footprint L along the front by W deep and height H (m), its pieces, each part's role (in the pieces' part order) and colourways (role -> linear colour; the first is the pieces' own). Sets: estate (brick new-builds), villa (Edwardian and inter-war), render (rendered, painted, weatherboarded). World/WorldRideHouseKit.cpp lays them on the map's detached houses whose footprint one fits.
